title: Sandro Marcos’ district gets P4.38-B more funds for public works | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Sandro Marcos, DPWH, Alex Eala

blocks.text: Today’s headlines: Sandro Marcos, DPWH, Alex Eala
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: House increases DPWH budget for Sandro Marcos’ district by P4.3B – watchdog

blocks.text: House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos’s congressional district in Ilocos Norte receives the biggest increase in public works funding in the approved 2027 House spending bill.

items: Dizon returns to DOTr, Lopez takes over DPWH in Marcos Cabinet reshuffle

blocks.text: Vince Dizon leaves the Department of Public Works and Highways after more than a year after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. appointed him to lead the agency and address corruption concerns.

items: Gasoline prices get a rollback, diesel prices rise again on October 27

blocks.text: Gasoline prices are set to ease while diesel prices rise for a second straight week starting Tuesday, October 27.

items: Lula, Brazil’s iconic working-class president, wins historic 4th term in dramatic comeback

blocks.text: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva wins an unprecedented fourth term, defeating Senator Flavio Bolsonaro.

items: Alex Eala back on track after defeating Mika Stojsavljevic in Toray Pan Pacific Open

blocks.text: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala defeats Great Britain’s Mika Stojsavljevic, 6-1, 6-2, in the round-of-32 match of the Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, Japan. – Rappler.com
